svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"cord-aide-de-camp","name":"USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip)","size_in":{"w":5,"h":4.48},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,500,448],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903. Shoulder run 4.2 in matches the garment shoulder seam; braid 0.30 in; the hanging parts are measured in braid thicknesses B from Vanguard SKU 3710210 (800 x 667 screenshot, B = 21.5 px +-1.5): free loop 5.9 x 4.7 B outer = 1.77 x 1.41 in, whipping 0.9 x 2.6 B, thin cord 3.9 B long and 0.14 B thick, pencil tip 88 px = 4.1 B = 1.2 in (the figure the earlier version estimated as 1.15 in); where the loop hangs from the run (3.3 in from the neck end) and the 4.0 in drop to the tip point are estimated","provenance":"in-house construction from DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1 (\"silver, single loop, chrome tip with raised wing and star emblem\") and the proportions of the Vanguard aluminum service aiguillette photo (assets/cords/ref/);
